registration.order: Rotate mode/workload order by trial; alternate engine order. Fixed repetitions across builds/modes. No per-call profiling or timed searches.

driverIpFields: Driver ipAttempts/ipSamples/ipFailures refer only to the disabled in-process software sampler. Hardware counts are in captureStatistics.
limitations: Five profiled trials per mode and seven plain controls. Interleaved blocks reduce drift but do not remove it. Confidence intervals are descriptive.
CPU Profiler and Time Profiler use their shipped templates; their overhead includes those templates’ auxiliary facilities. Minimal PMI packages isolate explicit stack requests.
Launcher child CPU includes the target and reaped descendants plus startup/save work; it excludes persistent system collector daemons. Subtraction is not total collector CPU.
Lost sample counts are unavailable in these exports, not assumed zero.
